responsibility: Constructs IRA conflict information between allocno objects and augments it with copy and hard-register-conflict data. It builds the live-range-based object conflict table (subject to size limits), canonicalizes subobject conflicts, derives per-object conflict arrays and total/confined hard-register conflict sets, propagates copy information across regions, and applies special restrictions such as caller-save pressure, debug-at-O0 clobber avoidance, and paradoxical-subreg exclusions. This file is IRA’s conflict-graph and hard-reg-conflict builder, distinct from live-range generation and coloring.
